title: Canonical small completed ringed site and coefficient transport
statement: For a scheme X and adic coefficient datum d, use AsSmall X.ProEt, the topology induced along the inverse of AsSmall.equiv, and the pullback of the actual completed coefficient ring. Use Mathlib pushforwardPushforwardEquivalence for modules and its derived equivalence. The scalar section of a in A is the actual compatible-residue scalar followed by the specified completed coefficient comparison and reindexing. The map from the small-site regular module to the transported original regular module is the map classified by the global section 1. These are [def-weil-pbc-intrinsic-completion, def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-complete, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] in a common small-site universe.
